package openfields_test

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	goahttp "goa.design/goa/v3/http"
	genclient "open-fields.example/gen/jsonrpc/mcp_tools/client"
	genserver "open-fields.example/gen/jsonrpc/mcp_tools/server"
	genmcp "open-fields.example/gen/mcp_tools"
)

func TestGeneratedMCPExtraMembers(t *testing.T) {
	for _, mode := range []string{"form", "url"} {
		t.Run(mode, func(t *testing.T) {
			extras := map[string]json.RawMessage{"extra": json.RawMessage(`{"integer":9007199254740993123456789,"nested":[null,{"x":true}]}`), "null": json.RawMessage(`null`), "MESSAGE": json.RawMessage(`"extra value"`), "MODE": json.RawMessage(`false`)}
			request := protocolRequest(mode, extras)
			encoded, err := genmcp.EncodeInputRequest(request)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			decoded, err := genmcp.DecodeInputRequest(encoded)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			assertProtocolExtra(t, decoded, mode, extras)
			state := "exact-private-state"
			result := &genmcp.ToolsCallResult{Outcome: genmcp.NewToolsCallOutcomeInputRequired(&genmcp.InputRequiredResult{InputRequests: map[string]*genmcp.InputRequest{"question": request}, RequestState: &state})}
			writer := httptest.NewRecorder()
			if err := goahttp.ResponseEncoder(context.Background(), writer).Encode(genserver.NewToolsCallResponseBody(result)); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			body := writer.Body.Bytes()
			if bytes.Contains(body, []byte(`"extensions"`)) || !bytes.Contains(body, extras["extra"]) {
				t.Fatalf("wrong wire shape: %s", body)
			}
			response := &http.Response{Header: http.Header{"Content-Type": []string{"application/json"}}, Body: io.NopCloser(bytes.NewReader(body))}
			var decodedBody genclient.ToolsCallOutcomeResponseBody
			if err := goahttp.ResponseDecoder(response).Decode(&decodedBody); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if err := response.Body.Close(); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			got := genclient.NewToolsCallResultOK(&decodedBody)
			pending, ok := got.Outcome.AsInputRequired()
			if !ok {
				t.Fatal("lost input branch")
			}
			if pending.RequestState == nil || *pending.RequestState != state {
				t.Fatal("changed state")
			}
			assertProtocolExtra(t, pending.InputRequests["question"], mode, extras)
		})
	}
}

func TestGeneratedMCPRejectsExtraMemberCollisions(t *testing.T) {
	for _, mode := range []string{"form", "url"} {
		keys := []string{"mode", "message"}
		if mode == "form" {
			keys = append(keys, "requestedSchema")
		} else {
			keys = append(keys, "url")
		}
		for _, key := range keys {
			t.Run(mode+"/"+key, func(t *testing.T) {
				request := protocolRequest(mode, map[string]json.RawMessage{key: json.RawMessage(`"conflict"`)})
				if _, err := genmcp.EncodeInputRequest(request); err == nil {
					t.Fatal("accepted collision")
				}
			})
		}
	}
	for _, raw := range []string{`!`, `{"x":1,"x":2}`} {
		if _, err := genmcp.EncodeInputRequest(protocolRequest("form", map[string]json.RawMessage{"extra": json.RawMessage(raw)})); err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("accepted invalid raw %s", raw)
		}
	}
	for _, input := range []string{
		`{"method":"elicitation/create","params":{"mode":"url","message":"first","message":"second","url":"https://example.com"}}`,
		`{"method":"elicitation/create","params":{"mode":"url","message":"known","url":"https://example.com","extra":1,"extra":2}}`,
		`{"method":"elicitation/create","params":{"mode":"url","url":"https://example.com","extra":1}}`,
		`{"method":"elicitation/create","params":{"mode":"url","message":false,"url":"https://example.com"}}`,
	} {
		if _, err := genmcp.DecodeInputRequest([]byte(input)); err == nil {
			t.Fatalf("accepted invalid request %s", input)
		}
	}
}

func protocolRequest(mode string, extras map[string]json.RawMessage) *genmcp.InputRequest {
	request := &genmcp.InputRequest{Method: "elicitation/create"}
	if mode == "form" {
		request.Params = genmcp.NewElicitationParamsForm(&genmcp.ElicitationFormParams{Message: "Choose", RequestedSchema: json.RawMessage(`{"type":"object","properties":{}}`), Extensions: extras})
	} else {
		request.Params = genmcp.NewElicitationParamsURL(&genmcp.ElicitationURLParams{Message: "Consent", URL: "https://example.com/consent", Extensions: extras})
	}
	return request
}
func assertProtocolExtra(t *testing.T, request *genmcp.InputRequest, mode string, want map[string]json.RawMessage) {
	t.Helper()
	var got map[string]json.RawMessage
	if mode == "form" {
		value, ok := request.Params.AsForm()
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("lost form")
		}
		if value.Message != "Choose" {
			t.Fatalf("known message changed: %q", value.Message)
		}
		got = value.Extensions
	} else {
		value, ok := request.Params.AsURL()
		if !ok {
			t.Fatal("lost URL")
		}
		if value.Message != "Consent" {
			t.Fatalf("known message changed: %q", value.Message)
		}
		got = value.Extensions
	}
	if len(got) != len(want) {
		t.Fatalf("changed members: %v", got)
	}
	for key, value := range want {
		if !bytes.Equal(value, got[key]) {
			t.Fatalf("changed member %s: %s", key, got[key])
		}
	}
}
